The student should restructure most of these sentences to identify the actor/subject without 'I', or replace the thesis-approach instances with 'we' used sparingly. locations.quote: **I** develop a self-service platform on which every grant carries an expiry date from the moment somebody requests it.
**I** evaluate the platform at the chair on correctness, administrative efort, and extensibility.
In this thesis, **I** develop a self-service platform on which requesters ask for time-limited access
Following the object-oriented software engineering method of Bruegge and Dutoit, **I** pursue four objectives:
**I** model the resources as a tree whose folders pass maintainership, audit policy, and grants down to leaves bound to target systems
**I** implement the keycloak-group, slack-channel, github-team, and webhook connectors, whose credentials administrators configure at runtime
**I** reach this objective when the webhook connector, written after **I** freeze the framework, needs one new class and one registry entry.
**I** evaluate correctness with an automated scenario that provisions SSH, Slack, and GitHub access from one approval.
Keycloak gates its workflow API on a realm-wide administrative role that maintainers must not hold, so **I** split each decision into a review step
**I** divide the work into six iterations of four weeks, each ending with a vertically integrated increment
Iteration 1, 1–28 October (Objective 1): **I** deliver the Keycloak realm with OpenID Connect login, SSH key self-service, and the resource tree with inherited maintainers.

generated.title: Review confirmation sentence omits the explicit purpose clause
generated.description: The guidelines require language similar to 'I have carefully checked all texts created with these tools to ensure that they are correct and make sense.' The current statement says 'I carefully checked all AI-generated text, revised it where necessary, verified every citation against the original publication, and compiled and inspected every diagram.' While the checking is confirmed, the explicit purpose clause 'to ensure that they are correct and make sense' is absent. The student should add this phrasing (or a close equivalent) to the confirmation sentence so it reads, for example: 'I have carefully checked all texts created with these tools to ensure that they are correct and make sense.'
